```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":false}}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<form><label>Message:</label><textarea>Default text content</textarea></form>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
